+def guarded_parts(value):
+    """Components the hidden/staging/traversal guards inspect.
 
+    For an absolute path inside this checkout only the components below ROOT are

requests.why: dot_local verdict product_defect (bazel_full-known-host-failures.json): validate_tool_arguments refuses the checkout's own `.local` prefix (tool_api.py:703 calibration, :634 arrangement_reference, :627 apply_capture_profile), so the same request succeeds from a dot-free checkout and fails from a .local worktree with no difference below ROOT. calibration_path() already confines calibration paths beneath ROOT/artifacts/benchmarks.
requests.doctrine: dot-prefixed, '.partial' and '..' components below ROOT stay refused, and every component of a path outside the checkout is still inspected (probe in bazel_full-known-host-failures.json)
requests.test_for_the_fix: the 8 failing cases (test_tool_contracts 5, test_arrangement_reference_tool 2, test_capture_application_tool 1) are the regression tests; they need a checkout path with a dot-prefixed component to exercise it (any .local worktree). A dedicated unit case is suggested for root's owner of tests/test_tool_contracts.py: assert validate_tool_arguments('phrase_evaluate', ...) accepts str(ROOT/'artifacts/benchmarks/x/i.json') when ROOT is patched to a path containing '/.local/', and refuses str(ROOT/'artifacts/benchmarks/.hidden/i.json') and '/elsewhere/.local/x.json'.
